title: Spots for Vertical MRO Kelowna filling fast
summary: Interest in the Vertical MRO Conference has been overwhelming and may sell out before registration rates increase on Sept. 18.
body_markdown:
Interest in the[Vertical MRO Conference](http://verticalmro.com/) has been overwhelming and may sell out before registration rates increase on Sept. 18. The world’s only educational, professional development, and networking event for helicopter maintainers, Vertical MRO (VMRO) takes place in Kelowna, B.C, from Oct. 5 to 7 at the KF Centre for Excellence.


“The helicopter MRO community is clearly excited about what we have planned this year based on the incredible response,” said Linda Reyno, co-owner of VMRO and MHM. “They have every right to be as this year we’ve added a larger variety of presentations and are introducing hands-on skills sessions, a leadership certificate tract, and will have aircraft on display. We encourage anyone planning to join us in Kelowna to secure their spot soon.”


Backed by MHM and *Vertical Plus* , Vertical MRO Conference was built for MRO technicians, engineers, managers, safety professionals and industry leaders to provide direct insight into the best practices, issues, and technology in today’s helicopter MRO world.


More than 30 industry leaders will deliver expert-led workshops, panel discussions, OEM insights, leadership presentations, professional development opportunities, and skill building sessions. Attendees also gain direct access to industry leaders, OEM representatives, and peers through networking events.


The 2026 Vertical MRO Conference features an expanded show floor, new hands-on sessions, a leadership certificate tract, plus on-site helicopters and equipment.


The conference also connects attendees with aircraft maintenance students and apprentices, part of a broader push to build the skilled workforce rotorcraft operations will need in the years ahead. Students and apprentices can register for free by requesting a code from VMRO events coordinatorMaddy Reyno .


Capacity is limited and seats are going quickly. Visit[vertic](http://verticalmro.com/)[a](http://verticalmro.com/)[lmro.com](http://verticalmro.com/) to register before spots before they are gone.


Already registered? Make the most of your time in Kelowna with this[Tourism Kelowna guide](https://kelowna-svp20.sendsites.net/L/F/Vertical-MRO-2026-Kelowna/P/MaddyReyno3www) .


*The Vertical MRO Conference is also being offered in the United States in Irving, Texas, Nov. 16 to 18, with a different program of presentations, speakers, and skill workshops. More info at[verticalmro.com](http://verticalmro.com/) .*
